verses.original: Καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ γάμος ἐγένετο ἐν Κανὰ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἦν ἡ μήτηρ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἐκεῖ
verses.transliteration: Kai tē hēmera tē tritē gamos egeneto en Kana tēs Galilaias kai ēn hē mētēr tou Iēsou ekei
verses.literal: On the third day a wedding took place at Cana in Galilee - Jesus’ mother was there
verses.literalPt: Ao terceiro dia, depois disso houve um casamento em Caná da Galileia, e achava-se ali a mãe de Jesus;

verses.original: ἐκλήθη δὲ καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸν γάμον
verses.transliteration: eklēthē de kai ho Iēsous kai hoi mathētai autou eis ton gamon
verses.literal: and Jesus and His disciples had also been invited . . . to the wedding
verses.literalPt: e foi também Jesus convidado ao casamento com seus discípulos.

verses.original: καὶ ὑστερήσαντος οἴνου λέγει ἡ μήτηρ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ πρὸς αὐτόν Οἶνον οὐκ ἔχουσιν
verses.transliteration: kai hysterēsantos oinou legei hē mētēr tou Iēsou pros auton Oinon ouk echousin
verses.literal: When the wine ran out - Jesus’ mother said to Him They have no more wine
verses.literalPt: Tendo acabado o vinho, a mãe de Jesus disse-lhe: Eles não têm mais vinho.

verses.original: Καὶ λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί γύναι οὔπω ἥκει ἡ ὥρα μου
verses.transliteration: Kai legei autē ho Iēsous Ti emoi kai soi gynai oupō hēkei hē hōra mou
verses.literal: Woman what is that to you and to Me - Jesus replied My hour has not yet come
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe Jesus: Que tenho eu contigo, mulher? Ainda não é chegada a minha hora.

verses.original: Λέγει ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ τοῖς διακόνοις Ὅ τι ἂν λέγῃ ὑμῖν ποιήσατε
verses.transliteration: Legei hē mētēr autou tois diakonois Ho ti an legē hymin poiēsate
verses.literal: His mother said to the servants Do whatever . . . . . . He tells you
verses.literalPt: Disse sua mãe aos serventes: Fazei o que ele vos mandar.

verses.original: Ἦσαν δὲ ἐκεῖ λίθιναι ὑδρίαι ἓξ κατὰ τὸν καθαρισμὸν τῶν Ἰουδαίων κείμεναι χωροῦσαι ἀνὰ μετρητὰς δύο ἢ τρεῖς
verses.transliteration: Ēsan de ekei lithinai hydriai hex kata ton katharismon tōn Ioudaiōn keimenai chōrousai ana metrētas dyo ē treis
verses.literal: Now six stone water jars had been set there for the Jewish rites of purification Each could hold from twenty to thirty gallons . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Ora, estavam ali colocadas seis talhas de pedra, que os judeus usavam para as purificações, e levava cada uma duas ou três metretas.

verses.original: λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Γεμίσατε τὰς ὑδρίας ὕδατος Καὶ ἐγέμισαν αὐτὰς ἕως ἄνω
verses.transliteration: legei autois ho Iēsous Gemisate tas hydrias hydatos Kai egemisan autas heōs anō
verses.literal: Jesus told the servants Fill the jars with water So they filled them to the brim
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes Jesus: Enchei de água as talhas. Encheram-nas até acima.

verses.original: Καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς Ἀντλήσατε νῦν καὶ φέρετε τῷ ἀρχιτρικλίνῳ Οἱ δὲ ἤνεγκαν
verses.transliteration: Kai legei autois Antlēsate nyn kai pherete tō architriklinō Hoi de ēnenkan
verses.literal: Now draw some out He said and take it to the master of the banquet - They did so
verses.literalPt: Então, lhes disse: Tirai agora e levai ao presidente da mesa. Eles o fizeram.

verses.original: ὡς δὲ ἐγεύσατο ὁ ἀρχιτρίκλινος τὸ ὕδωρ οἶνον γεγενημένον καὶ οὐκ ᾔδει πόθεν ἐστίν οἱ δὲ διάκονοι ᾔδεισαν οἱ ἠντληκότες τὸ ὕδωρ φωνεῖ τὸν νυμφίον ὁ ἀρχιτρίκλινος
verses.transliteration: hōs de egeusato ho architriklinos to hydōr oinon gegenēmenon kai ouk ēdei pothen estin hoi de diakonoi ēdeisan hoi ēntlēkotes to hydōr phōnei ton nymphion ho architriklinos
verses.literal: and the master of the banquet tasted the water that had been turned into wine He did not know where it was from but the servants who had drawn the water knew Then he called the bridegroom aside
verses.literalPt: Quando o presidente da mesa provou a água tornada em vinho, não sabendo donde era (mas o sabiam os serventes que haviam tirado a água), chamou ao noivo

verses.original: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Πᾶς ἄνθρωπος πρῶτον τὸν καλὸν οἶνον τίθησιν καὶ ὅταν μεθυσθῶσιν τὸν ἐλάσσω σὺ τετήρηκας τὸν καλὸν οἶνον ἕως ἄρτι
verses.transliteration: kai legei autō Pas anthrōpos prōton ton kalon oinon tithēsin kai hotan methysthōsin ton elassō sy tetērēkas ton kalon oinon heōs arti
verses.literal: and said Everyone serves the fine wine first and then the cheap wine after the guests are drunk But you have saved the fine wine until now
verses.literalPt: e disse-lhe: Todo homem põe primeiro o bom vinho e, quando os convidados têm bebido bastante, então, lhes apresenta o inferior; mas tu guardaste o bom vinho até agora.

verses.original: Ταύτην ἐποίησεν ἀρχὴν τῶν σημείων ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐν Κανὰ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἐφανέρωσεν τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτὸν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Tautēn epoiēsen archēn tōn sēmeiōn ho Iēsous en Kana tēs Galilaias kai ephanerōsen tēn doxan autou kai episteusan eis auton hoi mathētai autou
verses.literal: Jesus performed this the first of His signs at Cana in Galilee He thus revealed His glory and His disciples believed in Him
verses.literalPt: Com esse milagre deu Jesus em Caná da Galileia princípio aos seus milagres e assim manifestou a sua glória; e os seus discípulos creram nele.

verses.original: Μετὰ τοῦτο κατέβη εἰς Καφαρναοὺμ αὐτὸς καὶ ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκεῖ ἔμειναν οὐ πολλὰς ἡμέρας
verses.transliteration: Meta touto katebē eis Kapharnaoum autos kai hē mētēr autou kai hoi adelphoi autou kai hoi mathētai autou kai ekei emeinan ou pollas hēmeras
verses.literal: After this He went down to Capernaum with His mother and - brothers and His disciples and they stayed there a few days
verses.literalPt: Depois disso, desceu ele a Cafarnaum com sua mãe, seus irmãos e seus discípulos; e não ficaram ali muitos dias.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐγγὺς ἦν τὸ πάσχα τῶν Ἰουδαίων καὶ ἀνέβη εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα ὁ Ἰησοῦς
verses.transliteration: Kai engys ēn to pascha tōn Ioudaiōn kai anebē eis Hierosolyma ho Iēsous
verses.literal: When the Jewish Passover was near - Jesus went up to Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Estava próxima a Páscoa dos judeus, e Jesus subiu a Jerusalém.

verses.original: καὶ εὗρεν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ τοὺς πωλοῦντας βόας καὶ πρόβατα καὶ περιστερὰς καὶ τοὺς κερματιστὰς καθημένους
verses.transliteration: kai heuren en tō hierō tous pōlountas boas kai probata kai peristeras kai tous kermatistas kathēmenous
verses.literal: In the temple courts He found men selling cattle sheep and doves and money changers seated at their tables
verses.literalPt: Achou no templo os que vendiam bois, ovelhas e pombas e também os cambistas sentados;

verses.original: καὶ ποιήσας φραγέλλιον ἐκ σχοινίων πάντας ἐξέβαλεν ἐκ τοῦ ἱεροῦ τά τε πρόβατα καὶ τοὺς βόας καὶ τῶν κολλυβιστῶν ἐξέχεεν τὰ κέρματα καὶ τὰς τραπέζας ἀνέτρεψεν
verses.transliteration: kai poiēsas phragellion ek schoiniōn pantas exebalen ek tou hierou ta te probata kai tous boas kai tōn kollybistōn execheen ta kermata kai tas trapezas anetrepsen
verses.literal: So He made a whip out of cords and drove all from the temple courts both sheep and cattle He poured out the coins of the money changers and overturned their tables
verses.literalPt: e, tendo feito um azorrague de cordas, expulsou a todos do templo, as ovelhas bem como os bois, derramou pelo chão o dinheiro dos cambistas, virou as mesas

verses.original: καὶ τοῖς τὰς περιστερὰς πωλοῦσιν εἶπεν Ἄρατε ταῦτα ἐντεῦθεν μὴ ποιεῖτε τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Πατρός μου οἶκον ἐμπορίου
verses.transliteration: kai tois tas peristeras pōlousin eipen Arate tauta enteuthen mē poieite ton oikon tou Patros mou oikon emporiou
verses.literal: To those selling doves He said Get these out of here How dare you turn My Father’s house into a marketplace . . .
verses.literalPt: e disse aos que vendiam as pombas: Tirai daqui estas coisas; não façais da casa de meu Pai uma casa de negócio.

verses.original: Ἐμνήσθησαν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι γεγραμμένον ἐστίν Ὁ ζῆλος τοῦ οἴκου σου καταφάγεταί με
verses.transliteration: Emnēsthēsan hoi mathētai autou hoti gegrammenon estin Ho zēlos tou oikou sou kataphagetai me
verses.literal: His disciples remembered that it is written Zeal for Your house will consume Me
verses.literalPt: Então, se lembraram seus discípulos de que está escrito: O zelo da tua casa me devorará.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθησαν οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Τί σημεῖον δεικνύεις ἡμῖν ὅτι ταῦτα ποιεῖς
verses.transliteration: Apekrithēsan oun hoi Ioudaioi kai eipan autō Ti sēmeion deiknyeis hēmin hoti tauta poieis
verses.literal: On account of this the Jews demanded . . . . . . . . . What sign can You show us to prove Your authority to do these things
verses.literalPt: Perguntaram-lhe, pois, os judeus: Que milagre nos mostras, visto que fazes essas coisas?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Λύσατε τὸν ναὸν τοῦτον καὶ ἐν τρισὶν ἡμέραις ἐγερῶ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē Iēsous kai eipen autois Lysate ton naon touton kai en trisin hēmerais egerō auton
verses.literal: Jesus answered . . . . . . . . . Destroy this temple and in three days I will raise it up again . . .
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Deitai por terra este santuário, e em três dias o levantarei.

verses.original: Εἶπαν οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι Τεσσεράκοντα καὶ ἓξ ἔτεσιν οἰκοδομήθη ὁ ναὸς οὗτος καὶ σὺ ἐν τρισὶν ἡμέραις ἐγερεῖς αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Eipan oun hoi Ioudaioi Tesserakonta kai hex etesin oikodomēthē ho naos houtos kai sy en trisin hēmerais egereis auton
verses.literal: This temple took forty-six . . . . . . years to build the Jews replied and You are going to raise it up . . . in three days
verses.literalPt: Replicaram-lhe, pois, os judeus: Em quarenta e seis anos foi edificado este santuário, e tu o levantarás em três dias?

verses.original: Ἐκεῖνος δὲ ἔλεγεν περὶ τοῦ ναοῦ τοῦ σώματος αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ekeinos de elegen peri tou naou tou sōmatos autou
verses.literal: But Jesus was speaking about the temple of His body
verses.literalPt: Mas ele se referia ao santuário de seu corpo.

verses.original: ὅτε οὖν ἠγέρθη ἐκ νεκρῶν ἐμνήσθησαν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι τοῦτο ἔλεγεν καὶ ἐπίστευσαν τῇ γραφῇ καὶ τῷ λόγῳ ὃν εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς
verses.transliteration: hote oun ēgerthē ek nekrōn emnēsthēsan hoi mathētai autou hoti touto elegen kai episteusan tē graphē kai tō logō hon eipen ho Iēsous
verses.literal: After He was raised from the dead His disciples remembered that He had said this Then they believed the Scripture and the word that Jesus had spoken
verses.literalPt: Quando, pois, foi ressuscitado dentre os mortos, lembraram-se seus discípulos de que ele dissera isso e creram na Escritura e na palavra que Jesus havia dito.

verses.original: Ὡς δὲ ἦν ἐν τοῖς Ἱεροσολύμοις ἐν τῷ πάσχα ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ θεωροῦντες αὐτοῦ τὰ σημεῖα ἃ ἐποίει
verses.transliteration: Hōs de ēn en tois Hierosolymois en tō pascha en tē heortē polloi episteusan eis to onoma autou theōrountes autou ta sēmeia ha epoiei
verses.literal: While He was in Jerusalem at the Passover - Feast many people saw the signs He was doing and believed in His name
verses.literalPt: Estando ele em Jerusalém na festa da Páscoa, muitos, vendo os milagres que ele fazia, creram no seu nome;

verses.original: αὐτὸς δὲ Ἰησοῦς οὐκ ἐπίστευεν αὑτὸν αὐτοῖς διὰ τὸ αὐτὸν γινώσκειν πάντας
verses.transliteration: autos de Iēsous ouk episteuen hauton autois dia to auton ginōskein pantas
verses.literal: But Jesus . . . did not entrust Himself to them for He knew them all
verses.literalPt: mas o próprio Jesus não confiava neles, porque conhecia a todos

verses.original: καὶ ὅτι οὐ χρείαν εἶχεν ἵνα τις μαρτυρήσῃ περὶ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου αὐτὸς γὰρ ἐγίνωσκεν τί ἦν ἐν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ
verses.transliteration: kai hoti ou chreian eichen hina tis martyrēsē peri tou anthrōpou autos gar eginōsken ti ēn en tō anthrōpō
verses.literal: He did not need any testimony about man for He knew what was in a man
verses.literalPt: e não precisava que alguém lhe desse testemunho do homem; pois ele mesmo conhecia o que havia no homem.
